founder.quote: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful. privacyPage.title: Jamia Barkat-e-Haram Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: Shar'i Purdah Protection, Student Confidentiality & 7-Layer Enterprise Cyber Defense Protocols.
privacyPage.lastUpdated: Last Updated: August 2026 | Document Ref: JBH-DPP-2026
privacyPage.pardaBannerTitle: Sacred Shar'i Purdah & Absolute Student Identity Protection
privacyPage.pardaBannerDesc: Safeguarding the sacred modesty, dignity, and personal identity of female students is Jamia's foremost religious mandate. Photographs and personal details are strictly confidential and never published online.

sections.title: 1. Scope & Islamic Philosophy of Confidentiality
sections.desc: This Privacy Policy governs data collected across Jamia Barkat-e-Haram's web portal, student ERP system, scholarship entrance examination portal, and digital classroom applications. As an Islamic higher education institution for women, we adhere to the highest standards of Islamic Shari'ah and data privacy.

sections.title: 2. Information Collected from Students & Guardians
sections.desc: We collect verified essential data solely for academic operations: (a) Student's legal name, date of birth, and identity documentation; (b) Verified parent/guardian contact and residential address; (c) Prior madarsa/school credentials and entrance exam scores; (d) Smart class attendance and academic grades; (e) Fee and scholarship fund transaction references.

sections.title: 3. Strict Shar'i Purdah & Non-Disclosure Guarantee
sections.desc: Students' personal photos, personal phone numbers, and home addresses are never published online, indexed by search engines, or shared with commercial entities. Live digital smart classes are conducted exclusively by certified female scholars (Muallimat) with full camera-off / audio-only options for students.

sections.title: 4. 7-Layer Enterprise Cyber Defense & Military-Grade Encryption
sections.desc: All student databases and academic records are guarded by: (1) SSL/TLS v1.3 256-bit military-grade encryption; (2) SHA-256 cryptographic hashing for credentials; (3) Anti-scraping edge firewalls; (4) Cloudflare DDoS shield; (5) SQL Injection & XSS security filters; (6) Automated daily encrypted backups; (7) Multi-factor administrative access.

sections.title: 5. Smart Classroom Video & Lecture Recording Guidelines
sections.desc: Smart class recordings are archived strictly for students' academic revision in the secure app. Unauthorized downloading, screen recording, commercial use, or re-uploading to YouTube/Telegram is strictly prohibited and subject to legal and disciplinary action.

sections.title: 6. Zero-Commercial-Tracking Policy & Local Storage
sections.desc: Our platform operates on a zero-commercial-tracking policy. Browser local storage is used solely for core user preferences: (a) Language selection (English, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic); (b) Dark/Light theme mode. We do not run third-party advertising cookies.

sections.title: 7. Financial Data, UPI & Donation Privacy
sections.desc: All online contributions, zakat, and scholarship transactions are handled directly through authorized banking gateways (HDFC Bank Ltd.). Jamia never stores debit card credentials or UPI PINs. Bank transaction IDs are stored solely for official receipt generation and auditing.

sections.title: 8. Strict No-Commercialization & Non-Disclosure Policy
sections.desc: Jamia Barkat-e-Haram does not sell, rent, or trade student, parent, or donor data to marketing agencies or third-party corporations under any circumstances.

sections.title: 9. Student & Guardian Rights
sections.desc: Enrolled students and guardians hold the right to inspect their ERP academic records, request prompt correction of typographical errors, and request data archiving upon course completion.

sections.title: 10. Institutional Data Protection & Grievance Contact
sections.desc: For privacy inquiries, data rectification, or grievance redressal, contact our Chief Data Protection Officer at cgisbarkateharam@gmail.com | Helpline: +91 70806 54147 / +91 94151 46640 | Address: Jamia Barkat-e-Haram Campus, India.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.subtitle: Jamia Barkat-e-Haram's Institutional Rules, Entrance Examination Guidelines, Smart Class Protocols & Code of Conduct.
termsPage.lastUpdated: Last Updated: August 2026 | Document Ref: JBH-TOS-2026

sections.title: 1. Legal Agreement & Institutional Jurisdiction
sections.desc: By accessing Jamia Barkat-e-Haram's website, student ERP portal, mobile apps, or smart classrooms, you agree to be bound by these Terms, the Institutional Constitution, and all administrative decisions of Mujaddid Alf Sani Education and Welfare Trust.

sections.title: 2. Academic Eligibility & Admission Guidelines
sections.desc: Admissions to Takhasus fil-Ifta (Muftiya Course), Dars-e-Nizami (Alima & Fazila), Hifz-o-Tajweed, and Modular programs are awarded strictly on merit. Submitting forged documents or false declarations will lead to immediate cancellation of admission and forfeiture of scholarship.

sections.title: 3. Jamia Institutional Scholarship & Admission Test Rules
sections.desc: Applicants registered for Jamia Barkat-e-Haram's internal scholarship and entrance examination must download their official admit card from the portal. Malpractice, impersonation, or unauthorized electronic device usage during tests results in permanent disqualification.

sections.title: 4. Jamia 100% Scholarship Charter & Maintenance Criteria
sections.desc: This 100% scholarship is funded and awarded directly by Jamia Barkat-e-Haram under Mujaddid Alf Sani Education and Welfare Trust (not affiliated with any government scheme). It covers 100% tuition fees, hostel accommodation, and meals. Admission fees must be paid at enrollment, and curriculum books must be purchased by the student. To maintain the scholarship, a student must: (a) Maintain a minimum 85% attendance across classes; (b) Achieve at least 70% aggregate marks in semester examinations; (c) Uphold institutional moral and Shar'i conduct.

sections.title: 5. Student Code of Conduct (Campus & Online)
sections.desc: Students are expected to exemplify noble Islamic character (Akhlaaq), mutual respect, and academic diligence. Sharing live lecture links, spamming in class chats, or violating Shar'i Purdah protocols during video sessions is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property & Digital Curriculum Copyright
sections.desc: All curriculum materials, lectures, courseware, fatwa archives, and portal software are the exclusive intellectual property of Jamia Barkat-e-Haram. Screen recording, unauthorized redistribution on YouTube/Telegram, or commercial exploitation is illegal and subject to copyright law.

sections.title: 7. Official Sanad (Degree) & Certificate QR Verification
sections.desc: Every authentic Sanad and Certificate issued by Jamia Barkat-e-Haram carries a tamper-evident cryptographic QR code. Official credential verification is valid solely via jamiabarkateharam.edu/students/verify.

sections.title: 8. Zero-Cost Female Teacher Placement Cell
sections.desc: Jamia's Teacher Placement Cell operates purely on a non-commercial, philanthropic basis to connect qualified female scholars (Muallimat) with requesting Islamic institutions at zero fees or commission.

sections.title: 9. Voluntary Donations, Zakat & Non-Refund Policy
sections.desc: Online donations and zakat are directly utilized towards students' lodging, meals, and digital education. Once confirmed, contributions are non-refundable. Official donation receipts are issued immediately.

sections.title: 10. Dispute Resolution & Legal Jurisdiction
sections.desc: Jamia administration reserves the right to amend academic calendars, syllabus modules, and institutional guidelines. In case of any dispute, the decision of Mujaddid Alf Sani Education and Welfare Trust is final and binding under local jurisdiction.

faq.title: Admissions & Curriculum Guidance
faq.subtitle: Common questions about hybrid learning, hostel safety, scholarships, and certification.

items.question: Can homemakers and working professionals enroll in online tracks?
items.answer: Yes! Flagship courses including Takhassus Fil Ifta and Dars-e-Nizami are accessible globally through interactive live broadcasts, and 1080p recorded lectures are available 24/7 on the mobile app.

items.question: How can students qualify for the 100% Jamia scholarship?
items.answer: Candidates who achieve merit in Jamia's internal entrance examination and meet need-based criteria receive full sponsorship covering tuition, lodging, and meals funded by Mujaddid Alf Sani Trust.

items.question: What is the prerequisite for Takhassus Fil Ifta (Muftiya Course)?
items.answer: Applicants must hold an authentic Alimah / Fazilah Sanad (Dars-e-Nizami graduate) or equivalent Islamic degree from a recognized madarsa or institution.

items.question: Are issued Sanads and certificates verifiable globally?
items.answer: Yes, every official credential issued by Jamia Barkat-e-Haram carries a tamper-evident QR code verifiable worldwide through our official verification portal.

items.question: What safety and Purdah provisions exist for campus residents?
items.answer: Our residential campus maintains strict Shar'i Purdah protocols, round-the-clock female faculty supervision, and secure, peaceful hostel amenities.
